item.title: Pork Belly Radish Skewers
item.description: I am a big fan of skewers. They’re easy to make, fun to eat, and almost every food culture in the world has some kind of skewer dish. This combination is one of my favorites. The fat of the pork belly combined with the crunchy radish and the gochujang is just too tasty not to try. You can either grill them over direct heat or put them in the oven on broil mode.
